lead: Footwear a person owns, organised by family (sneakers, sports and outdoor shoes, dress shoes, heels and flats, boots, sandals, traditional footwear, slippers, care), then kind, then named archetype and version.

b.w: Collectors identify a pair by silhouette, release and style code first (StockX/GOAT/KicksDB).
Resale buying turns on a verified genuine pair.
Condition sets resale value.
Limited releases rank above general releases for collectors.
